name: arrow-down-right
description: A down and right-facing navigation arrow with a straight shaft and a solid rounded triangular head.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Round 5 completes the eight compass arrows. Rotate the approved Arrow Right straight shaft and V head by 45 degrees about 12,12, uniformly fit centerlines to a 9.15-unit primary half extent, then bake coordinates into source. Reference centerline points before rotation are shaft (4,12) to (20,12) and head (14,6) to (20,12) to (14,18). Centerline fit factor 1.6175067620; keep Regular1.70 unchanged instead of scaling stroke. Both horizontal and vertical visible margins are exactly2px. Outline keeps an open straight-arm V with .85 round caps and joins. Filled uses the exact .85 capsule around the same shaft and a solid triangle expanded by .85 round exterior corners around those same head vertices. Tips, shoulders and exterior align at Regular1.70; the solid head is the accepted semantic interior exception. No enclosing box, broad curved-head fillet or preview transform. Existing approved Left/Right artwork is preserved. Both new styles await owner review. Global weight update requested by owner on2026-10-27: default Regular1.75 (half-width .875), Thin1.25 and Bold2.50, adjustable in .25 increments. Filled is rebuilt from these same Outline centerlines using rounded normal expansion, with solid-head/boxed/object semantics preserved. Menu/Search Filled follows Bold2.50. Centerlines uniformly refitted about12,12 by 0.9972677596 to retain the existing2px primary margins and shared boxed glyph clearance. Earlier1.70/2.25 construction measurements are historical; the current default reference is1.75.

review.note: Round 5: new direction derived from the approved Arrow Right family, awaiting owner visual review.
